notes: The list covers the concertos, caprices, main showpieces and guitar duos well. The clear gaps are the eleven remaining sonatas for violin and guitar from Opp. 2 and 3, several later orchestral variation-sonatas (Varsavia, Maestosa sonata sentimentale, Militare, Polacca), and a few established Auer/Kreisler versions. Keys for Opp. 2/3 and MS numbers for the orchestral sonatas are given at medium confidence.
